subject: ProvingGround: evaluation asset exchange and closure runway
messages:
From: Tamara Lee <tamara@provinggroundretail.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Legal Ops <legal@provinggroundretail.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Evaluation assets & proposed MAP for pilot runway

Hi Rachel —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We had a constructive conversation internally and we
want to move forward with a short pilot to validate latency and behavioral parity for a
few retail search prompts. To keep momentum, our legal team asked for a short written
plan covering what we exchange, how long assets are available, and the usage limits.

Can Redwood provide:
- a MAP (milestones, owners, dates) for dataset/prompt exchange and acceptance gates
- example constraints (retention, no redistribution, ephemeral sandbox access) we can
  show Legal
- an engineer contact for sandbox ingestion questions

We expect this pilot to run ~3 weeks. Targeting a production decision by 2026-12-08.

Best,
Tamara Lee
Head of ML Ops — ProvingGround Retail

---
From: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tamara Lee <tamara@provinggroundretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evaluation assets & proposed MAP for pilot runway

Tamara, thanks — attached is a draft MAP and the prompt pack we typically use for this
class of verification. Quick summary up front so Legal has the highlights:

Key constraints (high level)
- Ephemeral sandbox: access granted to a pre-provisioned S3 bucket / temporary API key
  for 30 days from provisioning.
- No redistribution: datasets and prompt packs may not be shared outside the ProvingGround
  evaluation project; extracts for internal analysis are permitted but cannot be published.
- Data retention: Redwood will automatically purge any ingested customer-provided files
  after 90 days unless a takedown extension is requested in writing.
- Usage: assets are allowed for model evaluation, prompt tuning, and quality assessments
  only. No production inference against customer data without a separate production license.

Attached: MAP_Draft_ProvingGround_v3.docx, promptpack_pilot.pdf. I will upload the
eval_dataset_v1.zip to the sandbox once we agree on timeline and IP/usage bullets.

Proposed MAP (short) — owners and target dates:
- 11/11: Redwood prepares sandbox + temp keys (Owner: Dev Patel)
- 11/12: ProvingGround uploads evaluation dataset to secure intake (Owner: Tamara)
- 11/13: Redwood confirms ingestion and runs smoke tests (Owner: Dev)
- 11/16: First quality review, gap notes (Owner: Marissa)
- 11/20: Final acceptance / judgment run (Owner: Karthik)
- 11/23: Close decision and recommended next steps (Owner: Rachel)

If that runway looks OK, I can also send over a short one-page addendum Legal can sign
(accepts the constraints above).

Next steps: please confirm you accept the constraints or flag any non-starters, and we
will provision the sandbox.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Account Lead — Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: MAP_Draft_ProvingGround_v3.docx (18KB), promptpack_pilot.pdf (220KB)

---
From: Tamara Lee <tamara@provinggroundretail.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Legal Ops <legal@provinggroundretail.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evaluation assets & proposed MAP for pilot runway

Rachel — appreciate the concise MAP. A couple quick flags from Legal: they want a
minimal custodial audit trail for ingestion and deletion (simple signed receipt will
suffice), and they prefer the 90-day purge to be clickable / auditable in our contract.

Also, ask: can we limit sandbox egress so files cannot be downloaded, only read by
Redwood for evaluation runs? That reduces our internal exposure risk.

If Redwood can provide the ingestion receipt and an egress restriction option, we
are comfortable with the proposed dates.

Thanks,
Tamara

---
From: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tamara Lee <tamara@provinggroundretail.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>,
  Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evaluation assets & proposed MAP for pilot runway

On Tue, Nov 10, 2026 at 08:45 AM Tamara Lee <tamara@provinggroundretail.com> wrote:
> Rachel — appreciate the concise MAP. A couple quick flags from Legal: they want a
> minimal custodial audit trail for ingestion and deletion (simple signed receipt will
> suffice), and they prefer the 90-day purge to be clickable / auditable in our contract.
>
> Also, ask: can we limit sandbox egress so files cannot be downloaded, only read by
> Redwood for evaluation runs? That reduces our internal exposure risk.

Thanks Tamara — yes on both. Operational commitments:
- Ingestion receipt: Redwood will send an ingestion manifest (hashes + timestamp) within
  2 business hours of an upload and store the manifest in the project folder for 180 days.
- Purge audit: deletion events are recorded and we can provide a signed deletion notice
  with timestamp. If you need a contractual anchor, we can add a one-paragraph addendum
  to the evaluation MPA that references the 90-day auto-purge and the deletion notice
  workflow.
- Controlled egress: we can provision the bucket as read-by-runtime-only (no direct
  downloads) and restrict the temporary API key to evaluation endpoints.

Dev: can you confirm ETA to stand up the sandbox with readonly egress controls and the
ingestion manifest?

Thanks — I will attach the ingestion manifest template to the Doc we circulate.

Rachel

---
From: Dev Patel <dev@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>,
  Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Tamara Lee <tamara@provinggroundretail.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 14:06:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Evaluation assets & proposed MAP for pilot runway

Rachel / Tamara —
I can have the sandbox ready by 11/11 EOD PST with the following:
- S3 intake bucket with server-side encryption, access logs enabled.
- Temporary API key with scope limited to evaluation endpoints (no list/download).
- A small ingestion Lambda that returns a manifest (SHA256 hashes + object size +
  timestamp) and posts the manifest to the project audit folder (retained 180 days).
- Deletion job scheduled and webhook that triggers the signed deletion notice.

I'll upload a short README (how to run a smoke eval) and will coordinate a 30-min
walkthrough on 11/12 for your ML engineering team.

Marissa — please confirm you can run the initial quality checks on 11/13 and provide
an acceptance checklist by EOD 11/16.

Dev
Senior Platform Engineer — Redwood Inference

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel@redwoodinference.com>,
  Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Tamara Lee <tamara@provinggroundretail.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 08:02:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Evaluation assets & proposed MAP for pilot runway

All good on my side — I will run the gap analysis and baseline metrics on 11/13 as
planned. Deliverable: a 1-page QC note (coverage, sample failure classes, suggestion
for prompt adjustments) by 11/16 EOD.

Two small operational asks:
1) Please confirm until when ProvingGround will allow access to the sandbox team
   members list (we need a short whitelist to map user ids to test runs).
2) If the dataset contains PII, we will only run synthetic masking by default unless
   you specifically flag the fields to preserve.

Tamara — advise on PII policy or we will default to masking.

Thanks,
Marissa

---
From: Tamara Lee <tamara@provinggroundretail.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwoodinference.com>,
  Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evaluation assets & proposed MAP for pilot runway

Thanks team — this is helpful and we appreciate the clear owners. Confirming: all
constraints acceptable including the readonly-eval egress, ingestion manifest, and
90-day purge with deletion notice. Tamara (me) will upload dataset on 11/12 morning and
cc Legal on the upload email.

I'll also provide a short whitelist of team member emails for access; dataset contains
no direct PII (product ids, anonymized session ids only). We accept the default masking
behavior if anything is detected.

Approved next steps:
- 11/11: Redwood provisions sandbox (Dev) — done by EOD
- 11/12 09:00 PST: ProvingGround uploads dataset (Tamara)
- 11/12 11:00 PST: 30-min walkthrough with Dev + PG engineers
- 11/13: Marissa runs baseline QC and posts QC note by EOD 11/16
- 11/20: Final acceptance run and decision on 12/08 production window

Looking forward to the walkthrough.

Best,
Tamara
Head of ML Ops — ProvingGround Retail

Attachment stubs referenced in thread: eval_dataset_v1.zip (2.1MB placeholder, uploaded 2026-11-12 09:05 PST), promptpack_pilot.pdf (220KB), MAP_Draft_ProvingGround_v3.docx (18KB)
